title: potentilla verna var. minima
intro: Potentilla verna var. minima, commonly known as Dwarf Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant in the rose family that is native to Europe. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support immune function and reduce inflammation due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The plant is believed to possess therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antiviral activities, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and viral infections. Bioactive constituents of Potentilla verna var. minima include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
